scope: Single-run Stage-A failure-induction screening; not a treatment-effect estimate and not final external-validity evidence.

pass_if_any: degraded route is ineligible or not Completed while clean is eligible and Completed
degraded route completion is lower than clean
degraded score penalty is lower than clean
degraded has more pedestrian, vehicle, or layout collisions than clean
degraded has more red-light, stop-sign, route-deviation, blocked, route-timeout, or scenario-timeout infractions than clean

surrogate_safety_margin_degradation.actor_scope: route-specific hazard category, never the best post-hoc category
all_required: finite clean and degraded category-specific minimum OBB-TTC
minimum OBB-TTC drop is at least max(0.20 seconds, 20 percent of the clean value)
category-specific TTC <= 2 second exposure increases by at least 0.50 seconds
diagnostic_only_not_sufficient: one-frame minimum-TTC decrease without exposure increase
lower mean speed or more stopping without a safety-margin degradation

decision.failure_induction_pass: hard endpoint degradation OR all surrogate safety-margin requirements
decision.failure_induction_fail: valid paired run but neither degradation rule passes
decision.next_if_hard_pass: eligible for minimal oracle mechanism test and retained as a hard-case candidate
decision.next_if_surrogate_only_pass: eligible for a minimal oracle TTC/clearance mechanism test but not counted toward the final hard-collision/serious-violation case target
decision.next_if_fail: stop this frozen event without increasing severity, changing its region, or adding controls
decision.next_if_invalid: repair the implementation or environment and rerun the exact frozen pair only

global_claim_guard: At least three independent genuine collision or serious-violation cases remain required for the final hard-endpoint evidence; surrogate passes may support overall-distribution analysis but cannot replace that target.
